BREAKING — Javier Flores Jr. was arrested Tuesday evening, October 20, 2026, at 8:36 p.m., by the Laredo Police Department on a felony drug charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Flores was booked into the Webb County Jail (Booking #202608906) on one count of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 2, under 1 gram (charge code POSS CS PG 2 < 1G) — a state jail felony under Texas law. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The case is numbered #PFDC26-002956D4.

A Penalty Group 2 controlled substance in Texas includes synthetic drugs such as THC extracts and certain synthetic cannabinoids and stimulants. A state jail felony is punishable by 180 days to two years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000. Webb Watch 956 will follow case #PFDC26-002956D4 as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Javier Flores Jr. is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608906, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFDC26-002956D4).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
